name: Dja Faunal Reserve
description: Tucked into the rainforest of southeastern Cameroon, Dja Faunal Reserve is one of Africa's largest and best-preserved tracts of rainforest, with about 90 percent of it left untouched. The Dja River loops around almost the whole reserve like a natural moat. Inside live 107 mammal species, including many kinds of primates, and five of those mammals are threatened.
